metadata.title: installUnifi
metadata.description: Installs or updates the Unifi Controller running on Windows. Including downloading and installing the latest required version of Java.

findings.title: Network retrieval combined with code execution
findings.description: The same file contains both a network retrieval pattern and a dynamic execution pattern. This combination merits review and is not by itself proof of malicious intent.

evidence.snippet: $latestReleases = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/adoptium/temurin21-binaries/releases"  …  Start-Process msiexec.exe "/i `"$PSScriptRoot\java_installer.msi`" ADDLOCAL=FeatureMain,FeatureEnvironment,FeatureJarFileRunWith,FeatureJavaHome,FeatureOracleJavaSoft INSTALLDIR=`"C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\`" /quiet" -Wait
